description: Generate skills/prose-styleguide/SKILL.md from the resolved prose styleguide config and universal craft rules. Optionally publish AI boot files (CLAUDE.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md) when using sync-root config scope.

boot_files_overwrite.description: If true, rewrites existing boot files instead of in-place updates.

publish_boot_files.description: If true, also upserts CLAUDE.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md at sync root. Defaults to true.
